description: Fix 4 critical bugs blocking E2E pipeline completion: build task false-positive failure, stage regression on failure, agent timeout not enforced, skip-to-review deadlock

tasks.title: Fix build failed counter false-positive
tasks.description: In ralph-executor.ts, remove the unconditional `failed++` at line 525. The counter should only increment in the abort path (line 546-557), not in auto-skip (line 559-562), user-skip (line 539-542), or retry (line 543) paths. Also fix the retry scenario: when retry succeeds, the previously pushed 'failed' taskResult entry must be replaced with 'completed' to avoid duplicate entries for the same task.
acceptanceCriteria: All tasks pass: result.success is true, failed=0
All tasks auto-skipped: result.success is true, failed=0
Task genuinely fails (abort): failed counter is incremented, result.success is false
Task fails then retry succeeds: taskResults contains one 'completed' entry, not both 'failed' and 'completed'
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Root cause: line 525 failed++ executes before any skip/retry decision. Fix: move failed++ to abort branch only (after line 545). For retry: when taskSuccess becomes true on retry, update the existing taskResults entry instead of pushing a new one.

tasks.title: Fix stage regression on pipeline failure
tasks.description: In agent-runner-service.ts, remove stage rollback to Draft on all failure paths. Lines 328 (pipeline failure), 378 (exception handler), and 135 (orphan recovery) call `updateStage(issue.id, Stage.Draft)` — remove all three. Only set status=Blocked. Keep the current stage.
acceptanceCriteria: Build failure sets status=blocked, keeps stage=build
Plan failure sets status=blocked, keeps stage=plan
Exception handler preserves current stage (line 378)
Orphan recovery preserves current stage (line 135)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Three locations: line 328 (pipeline failure path), line 378 (catch handler), line 135 (orphan recovery else branch). All must remove updateStage(issue.id, Stage.Draft) and keep only updateStatus(issue.id, IssueStatus.Blocked).

tasks.title: Pass stage timeout to ACP session runner
tasks.description: In ralph-executor.ts, pass the stage timeout to `_acpSessionRunner`. The workflow loader (workflow-loader.ts) already defines timeout per stage (e.g., 1800s for build). Calculate per-task timeout as max(stageTimeoutMs / totalTasks, 300000ms floor) and pass it via the `timeout` option. When no timeout is configured, fall back to the default 30-minute timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: ACP session runner receives timeout from stage config
Per-task timeout = max(stageTimeoutMs / totalTasks, 300000ms)
No stage timeout config → uses default 30min
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: workflow-loader.ts line 52 defines timeout: 1800. ralph-executor.ts line 430-440 needs to read stage config and pass timeout to _acpSessionRunner. acp-session.ts already accepts timeout in options.

tasks.title: Fix skip-to-review deadlock
tasks.description: In api/issues.ts, the skip-to-review endpoint (lines 665-666) only sets stage and status. Add: setApprovalState with stage=Review/status=awaiting and emit approval_requested event. The approve endpoint already has fallback logic for missing pendingGate (checks approvalState.status === 'awaiting'), so pendingGate registration is optional.
acceptanceCriteria: skip-to-review sets approvalState={stage: Review, status: awaiting}
approval_requested event is emitted
User can approve after skip-to-review (approve endpoint succeeds)
After approval, pipeline proceeds to merge-back and done
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Mirror workflow-controller.ts:328-338 for approvalState setup. Need access to eventBus in the endpoint handler (already available). approval_requested event enables the CLI/frontend to know there's a gate.

tasks.title: Fix reopen to resume from current stage
tasks.description: In api/issues.ts reopen endpoint (lines 521-564): remove the hasPendingGate check and the reset-to-draft branch. When reopening a blocked/closed/paused issue, always preserve the current stage and automatically resume the pipeline via resumePipeline. This replaces the current two-branch logic (resume if pendingGate else reset to draft) with a single 'resume from current stage' behavior. Also update CLI help text in issue.ts line 252.
acceptanceCriteria: Reopening blocked issue at build stage keeps stage=build and auto-resumes pipeline
Reopening blocked issue at plan stage keeps stage=plan and auto-resumes pipeline
Reopening paused issue preserves stage and resumes pipeline
CLI help text updated to 'Reopen a blocked, closed, or paused issue'
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Current logic (line 521-564): if hasPendingGate → resumePipeline, else → reset to Draft. New logic: always preserve stage + resumePipeline. Remove hasPendingGate check and the else branch entirely. resumePipeline calls executePipeline which reads issue.stage and starts from the correct stage.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for all fixes
tasks.description: Add unit tests covering: (1) ralph-executor failed counter with auto-skip and retry, (2) stage preservation on failure in agent-runner-service, (3) timeout passing to ACP session, (4) skip-to-review creates awaiting approval, (5) reopen preserves stage and resumes pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: auto-skipped task does not increment failed counter
Test: retry success replaces failed taskResult with completed
Test: stage preserved when build fails (agent-runner-service mock)
Test: timeout calculated correctly from stage config
Test: skip-to-review creates awaiting approval
Test: reopen keeps stage and calls resumePipeline
All tests pass
Typecheck passes
